facts.subject: operational user
facts.text: Each named operational user shall authenticate with an individually assigned identity before accessing the Airport CDM Portal, Digital Briefing Room, or any operational console.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Platform
facts.text: Role profiles shall grant the minimum access needed to view, propose, approve, or administer operational data within the Regional Flow Platform.

facts.subject: System Support Engineer
facts.text: Operational approval privileges shall remain separated from technical administration privileges.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Platform
facts.text: Operational segregation shall prevent a single user from creating, approving, and technically concealing a material change to a Ground Delay Program, Airport Acceptance Rate, or Tactical Regulation Proposal.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Platform
facts.text: Where dual control is required, the Regional Flow Platform shall record the initiating user, the approving user, the affected operational object, and the effective time of the decision.

facts.subject: Performance Analytics Warehouse
facts.text: Access to the Performance Analytics Warehouse shall be restricted to authorized analytical roles and shall not allow retrospective alteration of operational records held in the Audit Event Ledger.

facts.subject: Audit Event Ledger
facts.text: The Audit Event Ledger shall capture successful and failed authentication attempts, role changes, privilege elevations, operational approvals, configuration changes, data exports, and emergency access activations.

facts.subject: Time Synchronization Service
facts.text: All audit records shall use time derived from the Time Synchronization Service so that investigations can reconstruct event order across the Airport CDM Portal, Slot Allocation Engine, and Alert Distribution Hub.

facts.subject: Audit Event Ledger
facts.text: Audit records shall be protected against ordinary user modification and retained for a period agreed by the airport operator, regional authority, and participating aircraft operators.

facts.subject: security monitoring
facts.text: Security monitoring shall alert the System Support Engineer and Data Governance Steward when unusual access patterns indicate possible credential compromise or inappropriate privilege use.

facts.subject: Identity Access Service
facts.text: The Identity Access Service shall support rapid suspension of accounts when a user changes role, leaves an organization, or becomes subject to an operational integrity concern.

facts.subject: temporary access
facts.text: Temporary access shall have a defined sponsor, purpose, role scope, and expiry time, and shall be reviewed after the operational need has ended.

facts.subject: Contingency Operations Console
facts.text: Silverpine shall accept emergency access activations only after the Identity Access Service records the authorizing incident reference and expiry time.

facts.before: records the authorizing incident reference and expiry time

facts.subject: Data Governance Steward
facts.text: Use of emergency access shall generate prominent audit events and shall require post-event review by the Data Governance Steward and the responsible operational authority.

facts.subject: access control
facts.text: During Contingency Fallback State, access control shall continue to enforce role separation even when some integrations are unavailable and manual coordination becomes necessary.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Platform
facts.text: When normal connectivity is restored, the Regional Flow Platform shall reconcile contingency actions with the Collaborative Decision Log so that accountability is preserved across the full incident timeline.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Platform
facts.text: The Regional Flow Platform shall record slot compliance events in the Audit Event Ledger using the operating date, flight identifier, airport, runway direction, and applicable regulation reference.

facts.subject: compliance assessment
facts.text: Each compliance assessment shall compare the Calculated Takeoff Time, the Target Off Block Time, actual off-block time, and actual takeoff time against the tolerance defined in the Business Rules Registry.

facts.subject: Slot Compliance State
facts.text: The Slot Compliance State shall indicate whether a flight was compliant, early, late, exempted, substituted, cancelled, or pending review at the end of the traffic period.

facts.subject: Audit Event Ledger
facts.text: The Audit Event Ledger shall preserve the time source applied by the Time Synchronization Service so that later review can distinguish operational delay from data latency.

facts.subject: Airport CDM Portal
facts.text: User decisions entered through the Airport CDM Portal shall be linked to the authenticated role provided by the Identity Access Service.

facts.subject: Collaborative Decision Log
facts.text: The Collaborative Decision Log shall retain the stated reason, decision time, affected flight, and visible operational context for each material change to a slot or sequence.

facts.subject: Slot Coordinator
facts.text: The Slot Coordinator shall review substitution activity after operations to confirm that priority rules were applied consistently across participating operators.

facts.subject: Tower Sequence Manager
facts.text: The Tower Sequence Manager and Ramp Movement Board shall provide actual movement milestones that support independent verification of slot performance.

facts.subject: Surface Surveillance Adapter
facts.text: Surface movement evidence from the Surface Surveillance Adapter shall be retained long enough to support dispute resolution and regulatory audit requests.

facts.subject: Performance Analytics Warehouse
facts.text: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall aggregate compliance outcomes by carrier, route group, regulation, airport operating configuration, and time band.

facts.subject: Data Governance Steward
facts.text: The Data Governance Steward shall verify that audit fields required for slot performance reporting remain complete, immutable, and traceable to approved data definitions.

facts.subject: System Support Engineer
facts.text: The System Support Engineer shall investigate technical gaps when audit sequences show missing events, duplicate updates, or inconsistent timestamps.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Manager
facts.text: The Regional Flow Manager shall use the Post Operations Report to identify whether noncompliance resulted from operator choice, airport constraint, airspace constraint, weather impact, or system issue.

facts.subject: Airport Duty Manager
facts.text: The Airport Duty Manager shall review late airport-driven changes that affected multiple flights and shall record whether the operational justification was valid.

facts.subject: Data Governance Steward
facts.text: The Data Governance Steward shall maintain the data ownership register and shall coordinate updates through the Business Rules Registry.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Manager
facts.text: The Regional Flow Manager shall own flow management policy data, including Ground Delay Program parameters and Tactical Regulation Proposal status values.

facts.subject: Slot Coordinator
facts.text: The Slot Coordinator shall own slot allocation reference data, including Calculated Takeoff Time tolerances and Slot Compliance State definitions.

facts.subject: Airport Duty Manager
facts.text: The Airport Duty Manager shall own airport capacity declarations, including Airport Capacity Plan records and Airport Acceptance Rate values.

facts.subject: Tower Supervisor
facts.text: The Tower Supervisor shall own tower sequence status data maintained for the Tower Sequence Manager.

facts.subject: Ramp Control Lead
facts.text: The Ramp Control Lead shall own ramp movement status data maintained for the Ramp Movement Board.

facts.subject: Meteorology Briefing Officer
facts.text: The Meteorology Briefing Officer shall own operational weather classification inputs accepted by the Weather Ingest Gateway.

facts.subject: Airline Operations Coordinator
facts.text: The Airline Operations Coordinator shall be accountable for airline-supplied schedule intent, readiness status, and Target Off Block Time updates submitted through approved interfaces.

facts.subject: Common Situation Display
facts.text: Freshness indicators shall be displayed on the Common Situation Display wherever stale data could affect sequencing, metering, regulation, or resource allocation decisions.

facts.subject: Time Synchronization Service
facts.text: The Time Synchronization Service shall provide the common time basis used for freshness calculations across the Regional Flow Platform.

facts.subject: Demand Prediction Service
facts.text: The Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, Slot Allocation Engine, and Departure Metering Service shall reject data that lacks a trusted timestamp.

facts.subject: Flight Data Exchange
facts.text: The Flight Data Exchange shall validate Flight Intent Message content before the data is made available for operational use.

facts.subject: Surface Surveillance Adapter
facts.text: The Surface Surveillance Adapter shall apply position quality checks and shall mark uncertain observations before they are used by surface decision functions.

facts.subject: Airline Interface Adapter
facts.text: The Airline Interface Adapter shall apply carrier-specific format checks while preserving the common operational meaning required by the Regional Flow Platform.

facts.subject: Handling Resource Planner
facts.text: The Handling Resource Planner shall validate resource quantities, task timing, and allocation identifiers against active operational reference data.

facts.subject: Business Rules Registry
facts.text: The Business Rules Registry shall hold the current validation thresholds, allowable reason codes, and exception rules approved for Normal Operations, Adverse Weather Mode, Capacity Reduction State, Recovery Phase, and Contingency Fallback State.

facts.subject: Data Governance Steward
facts.text: The Data Governance Steward shall coordinate discrepancy resolution with the responsible operational owner and shall record the disposition in the Audit Event Ledger.

facts.subject: Alert Distribution Hub
facts.text: Urgent discrepancies that could change a metering, arrival regulation, or slot allocation decision shall be raised through the Alert Distribution Hub and reviewed in the Digital Briefing Room.

facts.subject: System Support Engineer
facts.text: The System Support Engineer shall investigate technical causes of missing, delayed, duplicated, or transformed records and shall provide evidence needed for stewardship decisions.

facts.subject: Performance Analytics Warehouse
facts.text: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall retain data quality measures, including validation failure rates, freshness breaches, manual corrections, and recurring ownership conflicts.

facts.subject: Performance Analytics Warehouse
facts.text: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall calculate delay absorption as the portion of expected airborne or terminal-area delay that is converted into controlled ground delay before departure.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Manager
facts.text: The Regional Flow Manager shall use this indicator to verify that a Ground Delay Program reduced airborne holding without creating excessive departure congestion at constrained airports.

facts.subject: Tower Sequence Manager
facts.text: The Tower Sequence Manager shall provide runway sequence counts, while the Ramp Movement Board shall provide surface queue counts based on movement status and surveillance confirmation.

facts.subject: Slot Coordinator
facts.text: The Slot Coordinator shall review slot adherence by operator, airport, time band, and regulation identifier to detect recurring causes of noncompliance.

facts.subject: Capacity Assessment Module
facts.text: The Capacity Assessment Module shall record the available Airport Acceptance Rate used in each baseline so that avoided cancellation estimates remain traceable.

facts.subject: Performance Analytics Warehouse
facts.text: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall apply approved fuel burn and emissions factors by aircraft category, operating phase, and delay location.

facts.subject: Airport Duty Manager
facts.text: The Airport Duty Manager shall receive benefit summaries that show changes in stand occupancy, surface congestion, recovery duration, and passenger-facing disruption indicators.

facts.subject: Data Governance Steward
facts.text: The Data Governance Steward shall ensure that published performance measures identify data sources, calculation versions, confidence limits, and known exclusions.

facts.subject: Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System
facts.text: Training shall be role based and shall cover normal coordination, constrained operations, recovery actions, and degraded system use.

facts.subject: Tower Supervisor
facts.text: The Tower Supervisor shall receive practical training on the Tower Sequence Manager, Departure Metering Service, Arrival Regulation Console, North Runway Meter, and South Runway Meter.

facts.subject: Slot Coordinator
facts.text: The Slot Coordinator shall receive training on the Slot Allocation Engine, Airport CDM Portal, and applicable Business Rules Registry entries.

facts.subject: Airport Duty Manager
facts.text: The Airport Duty Manager shall be trained to recognize when an Airport Capacity Plan requires revision and when the operational state should move from Normal Operations to Adverse Weather Mode or Capacity Reduction State.

facts.subject: Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System
facts.text: Recurrent training shall be required at least annually and after major changes to the Regional Flow Platform, Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, or Flight Data Exchange.

facts.subject: Regional Flow Platform
facts.text: This baseline shall include the Identity Access Service, Time Synchronization Service, Audit Event Ledger, Performance Analytics Warehouse, and Business Rules Registry before any airport is permitted to exchange operational data.

facts.subject: Readiness Gate 2
facts.text: Readiness Gate 2 shall confirm that the Flight Data Exchange, Airline Interface Adapter, Surface Surveillance Adapter, and Weather Ingest Gateway can be connected without disrupting existing airport operations.

facts.subject: Demand Prediction Service
facts.text: The Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, Slot Allocation Engine, Gate Conflict Detector, Sector Load Monitor, North Runway Meter, and South Runway Meter shall be certified against agreed reference scenarios before they are used for operational recommendations.

facts.subject: Contingency Operations Console
facts.text: The Contingency Operations Console shall be available at each onboarded airport before reliance on the Regional Flow Platform is declared.

facts.subject: System Support Engineer
facts.text: The System Support Engineer shall provide round the clock on call coverage for production incidents affecting the Regional Flow Platform, Airport CDM Portal, Slot Allocation Engine, Departure Metering Service, Arrival Regulation Console, and Alert Distribution Hub.

facts.subject: System Support Engineer
facts.text: The System Support Engineer shall advise operational supervisors on technical status, known workarounds, data integrity concerns, and recovery options, but shall not issue traffic management instructions.

facts.subject: critical incident
facts.text: A critical incident shall be acknowledged within fifteen minutes and shall have continuous technical ownership until service is restored or an agreed operational workaround is in place.

facts.subject: high priority incident
facts.text: A high priority incident that degrades a major function without stopping tactical coordination shall be acknowledged within thirty minutes and shall be reviewed with the affected operational supervisor at least hourly.

facts.subject: high priority incident
facts.expression: reviewed with the affected operational supervisor at least hourly

facts.trigger: Regional Flow Platform cannot support safe collaborative operation

facts.subject: system
facts.text: The system should not automatically impose a Ground Delay Program, change an Airport Acceptance Rate, or alter a tactical measure without authorized human confirmation.

facts.subject: Flight Data Exchange
facts.text: The Flight Data Exchange, Airline Interface Adapter, Surface Surveillance Adapter, and Weather Ingest Gateway must be operated with monitored data quality thresholds and clear fallback procedures.

facts.subject: Slot Allocation Engine
facts.text: The Slot Allocation Engine, Departure Metering Service, Arrival Regulation Console, Tower Sequence Manager, and Ramp Movement Board must use the approved rules recorded in the Business Rules Registry.

facts.subject: Identity Access Service
facts.text: The Identity Access Service and Audit Event Ledger must support traceability, least-privilege access, and after-action accountability for all operationally significant changes.
